summary: Disable the retired st2 Claude channel alongside the other retired st channel plugins in each managed Claude launch's settings override.

replay.detail: No graph replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No storage, local ownership-record or replicated schema change.

rules.detail: No claim vocabulary or admission-rule change.

compatibility.detail: Managed st3 Claude launches explicitly set st2-channel@st2=false as well as disabling the retired st3 plugin spellings. Unrelated plugins, hooks, permission settings and the existing packaged/development channel policy are preserved. No global or shared project settings are rewritten or retired. Current embedded unscoped plugins remain idle without a selected subject; a subject or settings string is routing data, never independent kernel process-generation proof. Installed legacy plugin cache/executable identity remains unknown, so this is not an established cause or cure of a running seat's restart. Existing legacy generations remain unprotected under default-off ownership; both ownership settings stay off unless separately enabled.

manual.detail: No agent conduct rule, environment-stripping instruction, installer action or live settings edit.

recovery.detail: This delta changes no recovery counters, ownership enforcement or existing automatic and explicit restart guards.

downtime.detail: Source preparation does not qualify installed providers or authorize a rollout, live attach or restart.
